summary: Plan to fix (1) LT trigger calibration defaulting to RT due to "left" vs "LT" argument mismatch, and (2) RT trigger driving Left Stick Y to -32768 on PID 0x61EB by excluding all co-moving DirectInput axes during trigger calibration and cross-checking against Report 0x04 stick bytes (B12..15) and trigger bytes (B20/B21).
